reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
ABH IL will only reimburse for routinely performed serum iron studies for 
• 
Asymptomatic children aged 5 and under 
• 
Pregnant adults 
 
Claims that are submitted will be denied when 
• 
The patient is older than 5 and the only corresponding diagnosis reported is for screening 
or examination without abnormal findings 
• 
The patient is a non-pregnant adult 
 
The medical record documentation is expected to support the specific CPT, HCPCS and ICD-10-
CM code(s) and any applicable modifier(s) reported.

This policy outlines the coding and editing guidelines for reporting routinely performed 
laboratory serum iron studies. This policy applies to all professional and facility claim types.

reporting of Laboratory- Serum Iron Studies. This policy aligns with guidance from the American
Academy of Family Physicians (AAFP), the American Academy of Pediatrics and the United
States Preventative Services Task Force.

laboratory serum iron studies. This policy applies to all professional and facility claim types.
